summary: Aermotor MC-39 steel tower built in 1934 on an 8,531 ft peak on the White Mountain Apache reservation; registered 2002 and listed as standing.

facts.design: Aermotor MC-39 steel tower with a 7 x 7 ft cab
facts.agency: White Mountain Apache Agency (administers; also cooperator)

events.note: Constructed in 1934, per the NHLR detail page

evidence.supports: built 1934 as an Aermotor MC-39 steel tower with a 7 x 7 ft cab on an 8,531 ft mountain
evidence.quote: Constructed in 1934, Odart Mountain Lookout is an Aermotor MC-39 steel tower with a 7' x 7' cab atop an 8,531' mountain.

evidence.supports: tower rises 82 ft above the summit
evidence.quote: The White Mountain Apache Agency tower itself rises an additional 82'.

evidence.supports: administered by the White Mountain Apache Agency
evidence.quote: Administered by White Mountain Apache Agency

evidence.supports: on the White Mountain/Fort Apache Reservation in Apache County
listed as a standing tower with NHLR US 463, AZ 48
evidence.quote: Odart Mountain Apache 33.72847 -109.64883 Tower Standing NHLR US 463, AZ 48

notes_for_editor: History rests on the NHLR detail page alone; the FFLA list gives status only. Two web searches found no independent history, staffing, fire record or access rule. Search snippets gave other elevations (2,590 m; 8,525 ft) that I did not confirm from a fetched page, so they are not used. The record had no build year; 1934 is added from the NHLR. Access is left out of facts because no source states a visiting rule. Coordinates differ by under 100 m between NHLR and FFLA.
